contradictions.detail: The listing's spec block says 'Interior: Gray', while the overview and description say Auburn Nappa leather. The photos confirm Auburn.
CarGurus shows 'Price includes fees', but the dealer disclaimer says prices exclude document preparation, emissions and other charges. The out-the-door figure needs to be confirmed in writing.

The description says service was done 'almost exclusively at authorized Mazda dealerships'. Carfax shows most 2018-2023 visits at Volkswagen Thousand Oaks; Carfax notes it appears to be the same dealer group as Mazda Thousand Oaks.

critical_evidence.evidence: Carfax documents dated oil/filter changes every 6-12 months through 2024, plus 09/01/2026. However, it has no reported brake fluid flush entry in nearly 10 years, and there is a ~21-month gap from 11/2024 to 09/2026. The oil half is satisfied; the brake fluid half is not.

This is a late-2016 build (offered for sale 12/27/2016), which falls in the early-ND 6MT risk window. Carfax has no reported transmission, clutch or warranty driveline entry. That is not proof nothing was done. No door-jamb build-date photo was examined here.

This is an RF, so soft-top fabric does not apply, but the targa seals and drains behind the seats do. The interior photos show clean Auburn seats. Footwell carpet, the drain area and seat-rail bolts were not examined here.

The Carfax as of 10/27/2026 states 'no open recalls'. Campaign 19V072000 does not apply (automatic only). Airbag-module campaign 24V695000 applies to this model, and no completion line is visible in the history. Confirm with an NHTSA VIN lookup or a dealer printout.

The dealer claims 7-8/32 tread. The photo shows aftermarket Hankook V12 evo2 tires, but no DOT date is legible and there is no reported tire purchase. For the battery, there is only a 12/30/2023 'battery/charging checked' entry; no replacement is recorded.

documentation.rationale: The identity side is solid: VIN, a dealer-provided Carfax with 25 service entries, one California owner, a clean guaranteed title and a passed smog on 09/23/2026. Maintenance evidence is partial. It shows oil changes by time but no itemized invoices and no brake fluid, coolant, gearbox/diff fluid or build-date evidence. There are no photos of the at-risk areas (footwells, drains, underside).

condition.rationale: The exterior and Auburn interior photos look clean, with no visible damage. The car appears stock and the tread is claimed healthy. However, there is no PPI, no tire dates, no underside or footwell photos, and no driveline evidence on an early-build 6MT.

price_value.rationale: The $23,540 ask sits above the $18,933-$21,401 fair-value band (mid $19,874), and CarGurus itself flags it $1,224 above market. The closest comp, a 49k-mile RF Launch Edition, sold for $20,000. The Launch Edition spec earns some premium, but not the full gap.

mission_fit.rationale: This is a manual, reliable, simple roadster on a one-owner California car, easy to resell in 6-24 months, and it suits Highway 1 driving. The price sits above the $10,000-$19,000 ideal band but under the $27,000 ceiling.

logistics.rationale: Costa Mesa is a short flight or a day's drive from Carmel. A dealer seller makes a PPI plausible, though it is not confirmed. California smog is already passed, so registration is straightforward.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Several desirable traits combine here: an RF Launch Edition (limited run), Machine Gray with the black roof, Auburn Nappa interior, a 6-speed manual, unmodified, and one owner. It is held back from higher by the ND1 155 hp engine.

evidence.mission_note: A manual, unmodified, one-owner California ND RF fits the enthusiast-bridge brief directly. It is reliable, easy to resell and sits under the $27,000 ceiling, though it is priced above the ideal band.
evidence.rationale: The dealer-provided Carfax verifies identity, one California owner since 01/2017, a clean guaranteed title, no reported accidents, and a mileage trail consistent with 48,496 mi. The same report shows regular oil service at dealer-group shops and a smog pass on 09/23/2026. It has no reported entries for brake fluid, coolant, transmission or diff fluid in nearly 10 years, and there is a ~21-month gap before the September 2026 service. The photos show a clean, stock Launch Edition with Machine Gray paint, Auburn Nappa interior and matching Hankook tires, but tire dates, the battery, footwells, roof drains and the underside were not examined here. As a late-2016 build, the 6MT falls in the early-ND gearbox risk window, and no build-date or driveline records are provided. The $23,540 ask sits above the $18,933-$21,401 fair-value band; the closest comp, a 49k-mile Launch Edition, sold for $20,000. The listing's minor inconsistencies (interior colour field, fee wording) do not touch identity.
evidence.next_action: Ask Supreme Motors for the door-jamb build-date photo, tire DOT and battery date codes, a written out-the-door price, and confirmation that an independent PPI can be done before any deposit.
